map.阵发性睡眠性血红蛋白尿症（PNH）流式细胞术检测结果解读与克隆大小评估: Interpretation of paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria (PNH) flow cytometry results and clone size assessment
map.流式见 CD55/CD59 缺失群，按粒细胞克隆大小分型并判临床意义: Flow cytometry shows a CD55/CD59-deficient population; type it by granulocyte clone size and judge clinical significance
map.结合 LDH、Hb、血栓史评估溶血负荷与治疗指征: Combine LDH, Hb and thrombosis history to assess hemolytic load and treatment indications
map.区分大克隆(≥50%)/显著(10–50%)/微小(1–10%)，决定补体抑制治: Distinguish large clones (≥50%) / significant (10–50%) / minor (1–10%), which determines complement inhibitor therapy
map.：克隆分型：I 型正常 + II 型(部分缺失) + III 型(完全缺失) =: : clone typing: type I normal + type II (partial deficiency) + type III (complete deficiency) = 100%; total PNH clone = type II + III. Grading: ≥50% large clone, 10–50% clinically significant, 1–10% minor, <1% subclinical. Type III is most complement-sensitive and the main source of hemolysis; LDH>250 indicates active hemolysis and >500 a marked elevation.
map.：例（II 型=10%、III 型=25%、LDH=450、Hb=85）：总克隆: : e.g. type II=10%, type III=25%, LDH=450, Hb=85: total clone = 10+25=35% (clinically significant PNH clone), type I = 100−35=65%; type III at 25% ≥20% → high hemolysis risk; LDH 450 mildly/moderately elevated, Hb 85 moderate anemia. Overall, evaluate complement inhibitor therapy.

map.为什么看粒细胞克隆而不是红细胞？: Why look at granulocyte clones instead of red cells?
map.粒细胞寿命短、不受输血稀释，FLAER/粒细胞克隆最可靠；红细胞 CD59/CD: Granulocytes are short-lived and unaffected by transfusion dilution, so FLAER / granulocyte clones are the most reliable; red-cell CD55/CD59 is diluted by normal red cells after transfusion and often underestimates the true PNH clone, so the granulocyte lineage governs.
map.微小克隆(<10%)也要治吗？: Do minor clones (<10%) still need treatment?
map.通常不需 PNH 靶向治疗，重点排查是否合并再生障碍性贫血（AA/PNH 综合征: Targeted PNH therapy is usually unnecessary; focus on checking whether aplastic anemia coexists (AA/PNH syndrome) and monitor clone evolution regularly; intervene only if cytopenia appears or the clone grows.
